value.rationale: This is a naturally complete sharp robustness classification at the critical 9-dimensional sampling bandwidth on the minimal twelve-vertex spherical 4-design. It identifies a geometric adversarial failure already under two erasures, proves that all nonopposite triples retain injectivity, counts 60/80/80 mask types and gives the sharp noise-amplification factor. The precise error-correction behavior is not a normalization check or arbitrary parametrized example and supplies actionable geometry-sensitive sampling stability information.
